'''Gregory Robert Hancock''' (born April 18, 1963 in [[Seattle, Washington]], [[United States|USA]]) is a Professor of Measurement, Statistics and Evaluation. He is the current [[University of Maryland]] head of the Educational Department of Measurement and Statistics (EDMS) program.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.education.umd.edu/EDMS/fac/Hancock/greg.html|title=Gregory R. Hancock|publisher=University of Maryland|year=2010|accessdate=2010-03-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170810165349/http://www.education.umd.edu/EDMS/fac/Hancock/greg.html|archive-date=2017-08-10|url-status=dead}}</ref> Hancock also co-hosts the podcast ''Quantitude'', which focuses on quantitative methodology, with fellow statistician [[Patrick J. Curran]].<ref>{{cite web |title=About |url=https://quantitudepod.org/about/ |website=QuantitudePod |access-date=January 5, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001091756/https://quantitudepod.org/about/ |archive-date=October 1, 2023 |url-status=live}}</ref>
